description: The lights of the opening (the snowy street by day, then the alley that turns dark) for the modern lighting (rt_lights, docs/RENDER.md section 10). By day a sun and the sky, until the alley grows dark; then the match Harry strikes before he has a flashlight, which follows his right hand while the game draws the hand flame and flickers with it. Positions are metres, PS1 axes (y down); with a bone, the offset in the bone's space.

lights.name: Lighter
lights.description: The match flame in Harry's right hand: warm, small, flickering with the flame's own brightness; it casts the alley's shadows and lights the walls around him.

sun.description: The overcast sun behind the fog: one fixed direction for the whole location (direction is the way the light travels, PS1 axes, y down). The fog dims it with the distance from the eye, so its shadows are only crisp near Harry and the fog keeps its own soft colour; light passes through the gaps of fences and leaves (alpha holes of the textures).

sky.description: The grey sky's light on surfaces open to it: the bounce rays that find nothing above see it.
